tracking: ADR-0334 (lane E16): the brief is API-only; the browser governance screens are requested on #453 for the UI builder

gaps.GET /v1/browser-governance: reads browser governance settings (on/off, enforce/audit, prompt capture) and the policy key's public half for managed storage
gaps.PUT /v1/browser-governance/settings: turns browser governance on, audit mode or prompt capture (each a settings_relax step-up, audited), or back off
gaps.GET /v1/browser-governance/sites: lists the governed AI sites with each one's rule and required account domains
gaps.PUT /v1/browser-governance/sites/:siteId: allows a site (settings_relax step-up) or denies it, with the account domains the browser profile must use
gaps.POST /v1/browser-governance/enrolment-to: issues a capped browser enrolment token and the managed-storage config, shown once
gaps.GET /v1/browser-governance/enrolment-tok: lists browser enrolment tokens with their caps and enrolled devices (never the token)
gaps.POST /v1/browser-governance/enrolment-to: revokes a browser enrolment token: no new devices register with it
gaps.POST /v1/browser-governance/devices/:dev: revokes a browser extension device: its proofs are refused and it blocks every governed site
gaps.GET /v1/browser-governance/events: lists browser policy breach events (site, account and DLP blocks), pseudonymous
gaps.GET /v1/browser-governance/prompt-captur: reads one captured prompt (a pseudonym_reveal step-up, audited)
